Scenario: Fresh load generates a valid hypothetical draw
Steps: Clear localStorage, load index.html
Expected Outcome: 144 fixtures appear across 8 matchdays (18 each). Mode banner reads "hypothetical draw" (blue).

Scenario: Every team plays exactly 2 opponents per pot
Steps: Open standings, cross-check any team's 8 fixtures against js/data/teams.js pots
Test Input: Pick any team e.g. Real Madrid
Expected Outcome: 2 of its 8 opponents are Pot1, 2 are Pot2, 2 are Pot3, 2 are Pot4

Scenario: Home/away balance is exactly 4/4
Steps: Count home vs away fixtures for any single team across all 8 matchdays
Expected Outcome: Exactly 4 home and 4 away fixtures

Scenario: No team faces more than 2 opponents from the same association
Steps: For an association with several teams (e.g. ENG: Arsenal, Man City, Liverpool, Aston Villa, Man Utd), check any one team's 8 opponents
Expected Outcome: No more than 2 of them share the same association code

Scenario: No team plays twice on the same matchday
Steps: For any team, list its fixture on each of the 8 matchdays
Expected Outcome: Exactly one fixture per matchday for that team, 8 total, no clashes

Scenario: Regenerating draw clears predictions and switches to hypothetical mode
Steps: Enter a few predicted scores, click 'New Draw', confirm the dialog
Expected Outcome: New 144-fixture draw appears, mode banner still says hypothetical, previous predictions for old fixtures are gone (new fixture IDs), no leftover scores bleed into new draw

Scenario: Cancelling the New Draw confirm dialog does nothing
Steps: Click 'New Draw', click Cancel on the confirm popup
Expected Outcome: Fixtures and predictions remain completely unchanged

Scenario: Entering a score updates standings immediately
Steps: On MD1, type a home and away score into one fixture
Expected Outcome: Standings panel recalculates without page reload; the scoring team gets +3 (or +1 each if draw), goals for/against update, PL count for both teams goes to 1

Scenario: Draw result awards 1 point each
Steps: Enter equal scores for a fixture
Expected Outcome: Both teams get +1 point, +0 wins, drawn count +1 for both

Scenario: Clearing one score field treats the match as unplayed again
Steps: Enter 2-1 for a fixture, then delete just the home score field
Expected Outcome: Match no longer counts in standings (PL, points, GD all revert for both teams) even though away field still has a value

Scenario: Non-numeric or out-of-range input is rejected by the input control
Steps: Try typing letters, or a number above 15, into a score box
Expected Outcome: Browser's native number input either blocks non-numeric entry or the value is clamped/rejected by the min=0 max=15 constraint; standings never receive a nonsensical score

Scenario: Negative score is rejected
Steps: Try typing -1 into a score field
Expected Outcome: Input's min=0 constraint prevents a negative value from being accepted

Scenario: Points sort takes priority over everything else
Steps: Give two teams different point totals via predictions
Expected Outcome: Team A ranks above Team B regardless of GD or goals

Scenario: Goal difference breaks a points tie
Steps: Engineer two teams level on points but different GD
Test Input: Both 6pts; Team A GD +4, Team B GD +1
Expected Outcome: Team A ranks above Team B

Scenario: Goals scored breaks a points+GD tie
Steps: Engineer two teams level on points and GD but different goals scored
Test Input: 6pts/+2 for both; Team A scored 8, Team B scored 5
Expected Outcome: Team A ranks above Team B

Scenario: Away goals scored breaks a points+GD+goals tie
Steps: Engineer two teams level on points/GD/goals but different away goals scored
Test Input: Team A away-goals 4, Team B away-goals 2
Expected Outcome: Team A ranks above Team B

Scenario: Wins breaks a tie after the first four criteria are level
Steps: Engineer two teams level on points/GD/goals/away-goals but different win counts
Test Input: Team A 3 wins, Team B 2 wins (via different score patterns)
Expected Outcome: Team A ranks above Team B

Scenario: Teams level on all 6 criteria fall back to a stable, non-random order
Steps: Engineer two teams identical on every tiebreaker
Expected Outcome: Order is deterministic (by team ID) and does not change on re-render or page refresh with the same data

Scenario: Top-8/9-24/25-36 zone bars render correctly
Steps: Simulate all matches once
Expected Outcome: Ranks 1-8 show the green zone bar, 9-24 show blue, 25-36 show red, matching the legend

Scenario: Reset in hypothetical mode clears all scores to blank
Steps: Enter several scores, click Reset, confirm
Expected Outcome: All fixtures return to blank (no score, no OFFICIAL/PREDICTED badge); standings show 0 played

Scenario: Reset in real mode reverts to the real scorecard, not blank
Steps: With real-results.json populated and at least one FINISHED match, override that match's score with a prediction, click Reset, confirm
Test Input: Predicted score different from real result
Expected Outcome: Match reverts to showing the real official score (amber OFFICIAL badge), not blank; standings recompute from real data only

Scenario: Cancelling Reset's confirm dialog changes nothing
Steps: Enter scores, click Reset, click Cancel
Expected Outcome: All entered scores remain exactly as they were

Scenario: Landing page shows real fixtures/scores by default when data exists
Steps: Populate data/real-results.json with a valid non-empty fixtures array (see README note), reload with no localStorage state
Expected Outcome: Mode banner shows green 'real official draw and results'; fixtures use real team pairings, not the random generator

Scenario: Finished real matches display the real score with an OFFICIAL badge
Steps: Same mocked data as T23 with one fixture status=FINISHED and scores set
Expected Outcome: That fixture's score boxes show 2 and 1 with the amber OFFICIAL label; standings count it as played

Scenario: Scheduled (not yet played) real matches show blank, not 0-0
Steps: Mocked fixture with status=SCHEDULED, homeScore/awayScore null
Expected Outcome: Score boxes are empty (placeholder '-'); match does NOT count toward played total

Scenario: Overriding a scheduled real match shows a PREDICTED badge and counts in standings
Steps: On the scheduled fixture from T25, type a score
Expected Outcome: Cyan/green PREDICTED badge appears; standings count it as played with the entered result

Scenario: A stale prediction on a match that has since finished is dropped automatically
Steps: Predict a score for a SCHEDULED match, then update real-results.json to mark that same match FINISHED with a different real score, reload the page
Test Input: Old prediction vs new real FINISHED result
Expected Outcome: The real result is shown (OFFICIAL badge), not the old prediction — app.js explicitly drops predictions once a real match's status is FINISHED

Scenario: Missing/empty real-results.json falls back to hypothetical mode without crashing
Steps: Ensure data/real-results.json has fixtures: [] (the default placeholder state), load the page
Expected Outcome: Mode banner shows 'real draw hasn't been announced yet'; hypothetical draw loads normally; no console errors

Scenario: Unresolvable team name in fetch script is skipped, not guessed
Steps: Run node scripts/fetch-results.mjs against mock/real API data containing a team name not in team-aliases.js
Expected Outcome: Script logs a clear WARNING listing the unmatched name; that fixture is excluded from the written JSON rather than mapped incorrectly

Scenario: Switching from hypothetical to real mode via the banner button works
Steps: With real data available and currently in hypothetical mode, click 'Switch to the real draw & results'
Expected Outcome: Fixtures list swaps to real pairings/scores immediately; mode banner turns green

Scenario: Light mode is the default on first load
Steps: Clear localStorage entirely, load the page
Expected Outcome: Page renders in light theme (white/cream backgrounds, dark text) with no flash of dark mode

Scenario: Toggling to dark mode changes every section, not just the header
Steps: Click the theme toggle button
Expected Outcome: Header, banners, fixture cards, standings panel, footer, and on-page text all switch to dark colors — check specifically for any element with invisible/low-contrast text

Scenario: Theme choice persists across reloads
Steps: Switch to dark mode, reload the page (no localStorage clear)
Expected Outcome: Page loads directly in dark mode (no flash of light mode first)

Scenario: Toggling rapidly does not desync the icon from the actual theme
Steps: Click the theme toggle 5+ times quickly
Expected Outcome: Sun/moon icon always matches the currently-applied theme, never out of sync

Scenario: Exported image contains all 36 teams regardless of scroll position
Steps: Scroll the standings panel to the middle before clicking the export/camera button
Expected Outcome: Downloaded PNG contains all 36 rows from rank 1 to 36, not just the scrolled-into-view rows

Scenario: Exported image has no clipped/cut-off rows or garbled backdrop-blur artifacts
Steps: Export the image and open the PNG file
Expected Outcome: Every row is fully visible and legible top to bottom; no half-cut text, no visual glitching from blur effects

Scenario: Exported image reflects current predictions, not just real data
Steps: Enter a few predictions, export
Expected Outcome: Standings in the exported image match what's currently shown on screen including your predictions

Scenario: Export still works with zero matches played
Steps: Reset everything, immediately click export before entering any scores
Expected Outcome: PNG generates successfully showing all 36 teams at 0 points/0 played, no error thrown

Scenario: Native Share Image button appears only where Web Share API supports files
Steps: Load the site on a modern mobile browser (Chrome/Safari Android or iOS) vs a desktop browser
Expected Outcome: 'Share Image' button is visible on supporting mobile browsers, hidden on browsers/desktops that don't support navigator.share with files

Scenario: Native share actually attaches the real image file
Steps: On a supporting mobile browser, tap 'Share Image', pick any target app
Expected Outcome: OS share sheet opens with the exported PNG genuinely attached as a file (not just a link)

Scenario: Platform buttons (X/WhatsApp/Reddit/Facebook) download the image and open the compose window
Steps: Click any platform share button on desktop
Expected Outcome: Image downloads to your device AND a new tab opens to that platform's share/compose screen; a toast message explains the image needs manual attachment

Scenario: Cancelling the native share sheet doesn't throw an error or show a false failure
Steps: Tap 'Share Image' on a supporting browser, then cancel/dismiss the OS share sheet
Expected Outcome: No error shown to the user; no fallback download is triggered since the share sheet opening counts as success

Scenario: No TBD badges appear anywhere now that the real draw is complete
Steps: Look through all 8 matchdays and the standings table
Expected Outcome: Zero TBD badges appear anywhere in fixtures or standings — every team renders as a normal confirmed entry

Scenario: The provisional-teams banner does not show now that all teams are confirmed
Steps: Load the page with the current (final) teams.js
Expected Outcome: The amber "N of 36 teams are provisional" banner is absent/hidden — it should never render once the real draw is complete

Scenario: If a future edit leaves a team unconfirmed, the banner correctly reappears (regression guard)
Steps: Temporarily set confirmed:false on one team in teams.js, reload, then revert the change
Expected Outcome: The amber provisional banner reappears showing "1 of 36 teams are provisional" — confirms the banner logic itself still works and would catch a future data-entry mistake

Scenario: Predictions survive a page reload in hypothetical mode
Steps: Enter several scores, reload the page (no localStorage clear)
Expected Outcome: All previously entered scores reappear exactly as left, standings match pre-reload state

Scenario: Corrupted localStorage data doesn't crash the app
Steps: Manually set localStorage key ucl_sim_v5_hypothetical to invalid JSON via devtools console, reload
Expected Outcome: App detects invalid data, silently regenerates a fresh valid hypothetical draw instead of crashing or showing a blank page

Scenario: Switching browsers/devices does not carry over predictions
Steps: Enter scores in one browser, open the same URL in a different browser or incognito window
Expected Outcome: No predictions appear — confirms data is local-only, matching the privacy policy claim

Scenario: Mobile view toggle switches between fixtures and standings
Steps: Resize browser below the lg breakpoint (or use a real phone)
Expected Outcome: 'Matches' / 'Standings' tab toggle appears; tapping each shows only that section, hides the other

Scenario: Desktop layout does not show the mobile tab toggle
Steps: View at a wide desktop width
Expected Outcome: Mobile tab buttons are hidden; both fixtures and standings panels show side by side

Scenario: Draw generation completes reliably within a few seconds
Steps: Click 'New Draw' 10 times in a row, timing each
Expected Outcome: Every attempt succeeds (no 'Draw generation error' banner), each completing in well under 5 seconds

Scenario: An artificially infeasible team dataset fails gracefully instead of hanging
Steps: Temporarily edit teams.js so 5+ teams share one association within the same pot (violates the max-2 rule structurally), reload
Expected Outcome: Draw generation throws a clear error caught by the app; the red draw-error banner displays the message instead of the page freezing or showing a blank screen

Scenario: Reset This Matchday clears only the active matchday, leaving other matchdays untouched
Steps: Predict a score on MD1, switch to MD2, predict a score there, click Reset This Matchday while on MD2, confirm
Expected Outcome: Only MD2's prediction is cleared; MD1's prediction and played-count contribution survive unchanged

Scenario: Cancelling the Reset This Matchday dialog changes nothing
Steps: Predict a score, click Reset This Matchday, click Cancel
Expected Outcome: The predicted score remains exactly as entered

Scenario: Both reset buttons render as real buttons, not underlined hyperlink-styled text
Steps: Inspect #btn-reset-matchday and #btn-reset-all
Expected Outcome: Both are actual <button> elements with a visible border and no text-decoration:underline — previously styled to look like a plain text link, which read as unpolished

Scenario: Typing a multi-digit score registers every digit, not just the first
Steps: Click a score field, type two digits in sequence (e.g. "1" then "2")
Expected Outcome: The field shows "12" — regression test for a real bug where every keystroke triggered a full DOM rebuild of the fixtures list, destroying the focused input and silently dropping every keystroke after the first

Scenario: The score input keeps focus after each keystroke
Steps: Type one digit, check focus, type a second digit, check focus again
Expected Outcome: The field remains focused after both keystrokes — this is the actual mechanism of the T56 bug: focus silently dropped after the first keystroke’s DOM rebuild

Scenario: The native spinner up/down arrows work across repeated clicks without losing focus
Steps: Focus a score field, press ArrowUp twice in a row
Expected Outcome: Value increments to 1, then 2; the field stays focused between presses — arrow-key/spinner interaction hit the same underlying DOM-rebuild bug as typing

Scenario: Empty score fields show a "0" placeholder hint without counting as a real result
Steps: Load a fresh page, inspect an untouched score field
Expected Outcome: Placeholder attribute reads "0" (light grey hint), but the actual value stays empty and the match does not count toward played — confirms the placeholder is cosmetic only, not a real default score
